verdict.rationale: The product has a Skills API for uploading and managing skills, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for it. The llms.txt index and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation, and the Agent Skills specification defines a file format; neither is an API spec, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
